pattern.name: Mineral listening folds
pattern.description: Large unequal mineral panels meet at open diagonal folds. Long angular seams gather above the elephant while a broad counterfold remains at lower right; the field is clean and spacious rather than tessellated noise.

background.status: Designed presentation for the owner-delegated redesign batch; independent of native artwork and product UI colors.

framing.note: Uniform 90% placement with a downward offset moves the native lower neck crop through the bottom viewfinder boundary. The broad ear, natural face, curled trunk, tusk, and complete airplane retain their exact relative proportions. No anatomy extension or repeated edge pixels.

matte.calibrationNote: Native exterior samples are near-white rather than pure white. Border-connected extraction uses a source-specific matte sample; enclosed eye highlights and warm ivory anatomy are protected by connectivity and chroma. No connected-component cleanup is applied in this pass; inspect every remaining component and both light/dark boundaries.
